gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-sans-os: Pure synthwave swagger, drawn like thread stitched along a path. Outrun Future is all wide-set outline and short ascenders, while Noto Sans Osage fills its lowercase with inflated bowls and sweeping, open curves.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-odia: Bold letters, bent like straw, with terminals curling nearly to the stem. Plakkaat hits hard with joints that never thin or bulge, while Anek Odia, a plain sans, leaves its rounds unlatched.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend: Lexend reads wide and friendly, with outsized lowercase and open-jawed curves. Closed, heavy Plakkaat letters meeting those curves create a shut-versus-open split, and that split is the pair's whole charm.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-mada: Plakkaat bends one unbroken line into every letter, like straw. Paragraphs in Mada, a sans with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close, move down the page with an open, unhurried texture.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-nobile: Heavy, bent-straw lettering with terminals sweeping nearly back to the stem gives Plakkaat a closed, shut-tight look. Closed against open, Plakkaat and Nobile part ways most in their letter mouths.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic is a modern sans with a welcoming gap in its c. Noto Kufi Arabic opens up everything that Plakkaat closes, and that push and pull is the pair's best trick.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Heavy as bent straw, Plakkaat curls its terminals almost shut. Noto Sans Adlam, a sans-serif, keeps its curve endings well apart and its c, s and z full, so running text feels spacious and easygoing.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Heavy letters cut from wire, with joints that never thin or bulge. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, a sans-serif, opens generous gaps where Plakkaat closes its curves, and that tension is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-anatoli: Heavy and closed, Plakkaat bends its lines like straw, low in contrast. The heading does the shouting; Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs, a sans-serif, points its terminals outward and lifts its x-height near cap height.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Clean, open-tipped curves sit beneath the closed, heavy, bent-straw Plakkaat. Noto Sans Avestan, a plain sans, stands tall in the x-height, and that open-against-closed gap is the pair's best quality.
